messages:
maria: quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sampleapps. TL;DR: landed node quickstart edits, small nav restructure, spotted one mac-arm CI flake on sampleapp. blockers: mac CI failing on Samples; need a short doc note for the upcoming config rename. today: finish PR reviews + add migration blurb.

aj: saw the node quickstart PR, left a couple nits on wording and one snippet that still uses `yarn`. i pushed a commit to swap to `npm` by default. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/pull/214

sam: re: mac-arm CI — sampleapp tests fail during build with this error:
```
/Users/runner/work/sampleapp/build: error: Undefined symbol: _arrow_column_new
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64
```
I tried pinning a dependency to an older binary but that didn't help. unsure if it's the wheels on that dep or our build flags.

docs-bot: CI status for PR 214: checks running (3/5), mac-arm matrix job failed, rerun queued by @jess. See: https://ci.redwood.dev/quickstarts/214

jess: I can take the mac-arm flake. planning to re-run the job now and if it fails, i'll ssh into the runner and capture the full ld output. @sam can you paste `npm run build` output (with --verbose) here if it repros locally?

kevin: quick heads-up — i'm proposing a small config rename: `sample_config` -> `project_sample`. it's to avoid collision with future infra fields. will open a tiny PR and include a migration note in the quickstart that runs users through the change. no functional change.

maria: awesome, thanks. @kevin please include the migration snippet under "Breaking changes" with a one-line diff example. @aj i'll merge your npm swap after docs-bot clears checks. @sam if you can paste the verbose build output that helps @jess triage.

sam: running locally with `npm run build -- --verbose` now. output excerpt:
```
> sampleapp@ build /Users/sam/code/sampleapp
> tsc && rollup -c
Rollup v2.79.0
node_modules/native-dep/build/Release/native.node: invalid ELF header
error Command failed with exit code 1.
```
Looks like a native binary mismatch. maybe a dependency shipped linux-x64 binary.

jess: yep that's consistent with an incorrect prebuilt. i'll add a step to the CI to force-rebuild native deps on mac-arm before running tests as a short-term fix, and open an issue to track upstream wheel support. will report back in ~30m. :spiral_calendar:

maria: perfect. i also opened a small docs PR to add a "known issues" note in the quickstart about native deps on M1/M2 macs and the workaround to force-rebuild. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/pull/215

aj: lgtm on PR 215, added a tiny grammar nit that i can fix post-merge. :+1:

kevin: added draft PR for config rename: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/pull/216 — includes migration snippet and a changelog entry. please review.

maria: cool. summary: blockers acknowledged (mac-arm sampleapp flake), @jess taking triage, @kevin prepping migration doc, @aj tiny edits, i'll finish PR reviews and merge once CI passes. will follow up in PR comments. thanks team! :rocket:
